definitions.explanation: Describes the sound or manner of heavy, repeated footsteps, or of a group of people or things moving into a space noisily all at once.

examples.japanese: どかどか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk with heavy stomping steps.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どかどか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がり{込|こ}んだ→上がり込む：15198_agarikomu⟧。
examples.english: The children came barging noisily into the house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どかどか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{降|お}りて→降りる：00568_oriru⟧くる⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{慌|あわ}てている→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかった。
examples.english: The sound of someone stomping down the stairs told me someone was in a hurry.

notes:
A mimetic word (⟦{擬音語|ぎおんご}→擬音語：22536_giongo⟧) conveying heavy, noisy movement — typically of people with heavy footsteps or a crowd barging in. The voiced consonants reinforce the heavy, blunt quality.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どかどか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to stomp along
- どかどか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{入|はい}ってくる→入ってくる：29060_haittekuru⟧: to barge in noisily
- どかどか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧: to surge forward in a mass

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ドスドス: heavier, more forceful footsteps
- ドタドタ: loud, clumsy running or footsteps
- ぞろぞろ: filing in (a group moving in a line, less noisy)
